root_cause: resolveDeliveryMetadataAuthority treated a syntactically complete PR body as authoritative even when a valid versioned exact-head manifest existed for the same obligation. That allowed mutable stale PR metadata to override immutable candidate metadata and broke the existing authority contract.
prevention: When a valid versioned candidate manifest exists for the same obligation ID, it is the metadata authority regardless of whether mutable PR metadata is syntactically complete.
PR body remains authoritative only when no manifest exists or when the manifest belongs to a different obligation.
Keep the existing regression tests as the historical replay for both same-obligation override and different-obligation isolation.

evaluation.expected: Same-obligation versioned manifests override stale mutable PR delivery metadata; different-obligation manifests never take authority.
